notes.title: Small Patch: Difficulty Adjustment and Bugfixing
notes.content:
Balance:
Changed difficulty settings to be easier understandable
Added "Chill" diffculty with significantly more health and slower attack speed from enemies
Adjusted some enemy patterns on other difficulty settings to be more appropriate

Bugfixing:
Fixed an error where Shrivatsa (Expert) only used one attack
Fixed some inaccuracies in the languages texts
